properties.site-address: Former Nursery site and Car Park adjoining Newsham First School, Wharton Street, Blyth
properties.notes: Former school site, declared surplus and available for redevelopment following closure. Demolition and clearance of the school and associated buildings was progressed following an initial approval (B/08/00110/CPO). This was part of a wider proposal for renewal of education facilities, with the consent also enabling construction of a new 2-storey primary school land immediately adjacent to the east. After opening of the new school, permission was then granted for construction of 14 bungalows on the previous cleared land (16/04102/FUL). Development of 14 dwellings completed in 2018/19.
